info.title: DropHawk Developer API
info.description:
Product-level prices for PC components, tracked by DropHawk.

No key is needed.
Each IP may make 60 requests a minute, in bursts of up to 30.
RateLimit-Limit reports the burst; RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Reset are sent only on uncacheable responses.
Over the limit, the API answers 429 with Retry-After in seconds.

A successful GET or HEAD may be cached publicly for 5 minutes; every other response is no-store.
HEAD is answered like GET, without a body.
Every response allows any origin.
Unknown query parameters are ignored.

Every HTTP/JSON error is an Error (a google.rpc.Status) carrying one ErrorInfo with domain "drophawk.net"; branch on its reason, never the message.
Connect callers get Connect errors carrying the same ErrorInfo.
Errors raised before the API sees a request (an undecodable body, a body over 64 KiB, an unknown route) may carry none.

Within v1, changes are additive: new fields, endpoints, error reasons and withheld reasons may appear, so ignore what you do not recognise.
Removing a field or changing its meaning is a new version, served alongside v1 for at least 3 months.

tags.name: Products
tags.description: Look up Products and their prices.

tags.name: Catalog
tags.description: The Brands and ComponentTypes that organise Products.

CacheControl.description: "public, max-age=300" on a successful GET; "no-store" on every other response.

Location.description: The same endpoint for the surviving Product, as a path on the API's origin.

RateLimitLimit.description: The burst a caller may make back-to-back (30). The sustained rate is 60 requests a minute.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests left in the caller's burst. Left off cacheable responses.

RateLimitReset.description: Seconds until the caller's burst is full again. Left off cacheable responses.

BadRequest.description: The request cannot be served as sent. Reason INVALID_IDENTIFIER, INVALID_QUERY, INVALID_PAGE_TOKEN, INVALID_PAGE_SIZE, EMPTY_BATCH, BATCH_TOO_LARGE or INVALID_REQUEST.

MovedPermanently.description: The identifier names a Product that was merged into another. Follow Location to the surviving Product.

NotFound.description: Reason PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND when no Product is known by the identifier, or NOT_FOUND when there is no such endpoint.

PayloadTooLarge.description: Reason REQUEST_TOO_LARGE. The request body is over 64 KiB; retrying it cannot succeed.

TooManyRequests.description: Reason RATE_LIMITED. Wait Retry-After seconds before retrying.

UnexpectedError.description: Any other error, such as 405, 500 or 503. See ErrorInfo for the reason.

Error.description: An error response, in the shape of a google.rpc.Status.

code.description:
The google.rpc.Code of the error, for example 5 (NOT_FOUND) or 8 (RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED).
The HTTP status carries the same information.

message.description: The error code's name, such as "not_found", "resource_exhausted" or "internal". Not for display; branch on the ErrorInfo reason.

details.description:
Typed error details, each identified by its "@type".
An HTTP/JSON error always includes exactly one ErrorInfo naming why the request failed.
Other detail types may be added within v1; skip any whose "@type" you do not recognise.

ErrorDetail.description: One typed error detail, in the shape of a google.protobuf.Any. "@type" names its type, and the detail's own fields sit beside it.

@type.description: The detail's type URL, for example "type.googleapis.com/google.rpc.ErrorInfo".

ErrorInfo.description:
Why a request failed, as a machine-readable reason (a google.rpc.ErrorInfo).
The reasons are:

- PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND (404): no Product is known by the identifier, or it has been removed from the catalog.
- INVALID_IDENTIFIER (400): the identifier cannot name any Product.
- INVALID_QUERY (400): the search query q is blank, over 256 bytes, or has control characters.
- INVALID_PAGE_TOKEN (400): the page_token is malformed, or was issued for a different q.
- INVALID_PAGE_SIZE (400): the page_size is negative.
- EMPTY_BATCH (400): a batch request names no identifiers.
- BATCH_TOO_LARGE (400): a batch request names more than 50 identifiers; metadata "max_identifiers" is the limit.
- INVALID_REQUEST (400): the request is malformed.
- NOT_FOUND (404): there is no such endpoint.
- METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED (405): the endpoint does not accept that HTTP method.
- REQUEST_TOO_LARGE (413): the request body is over 64 KiB. Retrying the same request cannot succeed; send less.
- RATE_LIMITED (429): too many requests; metadata "retry_after_seconds" repeats Retry-After.
- INTERNAL (500): DropHawk failed; retry later.
- UNAVAILABLE (503): DropHawk is briefly unable to serve; retry later.

More reasons may be added within v1. Treat an unrecognised reason by its HTTP status.

reason.description: The reason, in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Treat an unrecognised reason by its HTTP status.

metadata.description: Context for the reason, as string values.

identifiers.description: 1 to 50 model_slugs or model numbers. An invalid one fails only its own result, with INVALID_IDENTIFIER.

client.description: Set to "mcp" only by the DropHawk MCP server, to attribute the links it hands out. Leave it unset; any other value is treated as unset.

BatchGetProductsRequest.description: BatchGetProductsRequest names the Products to get.

results.description: One result per identifier, in request order.

BatchGetProductsResponse.description: BatchGetProductsResponse answers a batch, one result per identifier.

observed_at.description: When the Retailer last confirmed this price.

retailer.description: The Retailer offering this price as of observed_at. On a tie, the one best_price_url resolved to when this response was produced. The link resolves when followed, so it goes to the current BestPrice, which may since have moved to another Retailer.

BestPrice.description: BestPrice is a Product's lowest current in-stock price and the Retailer offering it.

name.description: The Brand's display name, for example "ASUS".

product_count.description: Number of Products of this Brand in the catalog.

Brand.description: Brand is a maker of Products, with how many Products it has.

name.description: The Brand's display name, for example "ASUS".

BrandRef.description: BrandRef names the maker of a Product.

name.description: The ComponentType's display name, for example "Graphics Cards".

product_count.description: Number of Products of this type in the catalog.

spec_schema.description: The Specs this type's Products may have, in display order.

ComponentType.description: ComponentType is a class of product and the Spec schema its Products follow.

name.description: The ComponentType's display name, for example "Graphics Cards".

ComponentTypeRef.description: ComponentTypeRef names a Product's ComponentType, such as graphics cards.

is_carried_forward.description: True only for the point before the window: the latest earlier price, in force when the window opens.

DailyLow.description: DailyLow is a Product's lowest price on one UTC day across all Retailers, in stock or not.

DatedPrice.description: DatedPrice is a price and the UTC date it was observed.

points.description: Daily lows, oldest first. Empty when withheld_reason is set.

withheld_reason.description: Why points is empty: NO_DATA (no price history) or MIXED_CURRENCY (the points span more than one currency). Treat an unknown reason as no data.

model_slug.description: The Product the series belongs to.

is_merged.description: True when the identifier named a Product since merged into this one. Over HTTP/JSON that request is redirected instead, so a response is never merged.

window_start.description: The first UTC date of the 14-day window.

GetProductDailyLowsResponse.description: GetProductDailyLowsResponse is a Product's daily lows over the last 14 days.

ListBrandsResponse.description: ListBrandsResponse lists every Brand that has Products.

amount.description: The amount as a non-negative decimal string with a "." separator and no grouping, for example "1299.00". It usually has as many decimal places as the currency has minor units (2 for AUD, 0 for JPY), but may have fewer, or more when a price was observed more precisely: it is never rounded. Never reject an amount for its decimal places; parse it with a decimal type, not a float.

Money.description: Money is an amount in one currency. The API never compares amounts across currencies.

model_slug.description: The Product's stable identifier, derived by DropHawk from its model number, for example "deco-x1500-1-pack". Store and compare it as given; never derive it, since look-alike model numbers can be distinct Products ("U-PoE" and "U-PoE+").

model_number.description: The manufacturer's model number, for display.

component_type.description: The Product's ComponentType, which declares the keys in specs.

specs.description: Spec values keyed by the ComponentType's spec_schema keys. A missing key means the value is unknown.

images.description: Product images, primary first. Empty when there are none.

best_price_url.description: A DropHawk link that sends a buyer to the Retailer with the best price when it is followed, which may differ from pricing.best_price.retailer if the BestPrice has moved since, or to the Product's page when there is none. Use it unmodified.

Product.description: Product is a physical part at manufacturer-SKU level and its prices across Retailers. Only the Retailer offering the BestPrice is named.

url.description: Absolute URL. Its content never changes, so it can be cached indefinitely.

alt_text.description: Alt text for the image. Never empty.

ProductImage.description: ProductImage is one image of a Product.

best_price.description: The lowest current in-stock price. Absent when withheld.

best_price_withheld_reason.description: Why best_price is absent: OUT_OF_STOCK (priced, but none in stock), NO_DATA (no prices) or MIXED_CURRENCY (in-stock prices span currencies). Treat an unknown reason as no price.

in_stock_count.description: Number of Retailers with the Product in stock.

all_time_low.description: The lowest daily low ever recorded, dated to the first day it occurred. Absent when withheld.

all_time_low_withheld_reason.description: Why all_time_low is absent: NO_DATA or MIXED_CURRENCY (the history spans currencies). Treat an unknown reason as no price.

ProductPricing.description: ProductPricing aggregates a Product's prices across Retailers. A price that cannot be stated is absent, and the *_withheld_reason beside it says why.

is_merged.description: True when the identifier named a Product since merged into product. Store product.model_slug; comparing it with identifier is not a reliable signal.

error.description: Why the identifier did not resolve.

ProductResult.description: ProductResult answers one identifier. Exactly one of product and error is set.

reason.description: PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND or INVALID_IDENTIFIER, as GET /v1/products/{identifier} would answer. Treat an unknown reason as unresolved.

ProductResultError.description: ProductResultError is why one identifier of a batch has no Product.

name.description: The Retailer's display name, for example "PC Case Gear".

RetailerRef.description: RetailerRef names a store that sells Products.

next_page_token.description: Token for the next page. Empty on the last page.

SearchProductsResponse.description: SearchProductsResponse is one page of matching Products.

key.description: The key in Product.specs, for example "vram".

label.description: A human-readable name for the Spec, for example "VRAM".

type.description: "string", "number" or "boolean", naming the SpecValue field that carries the value. Ignore a Spec whose type you do not recognise; its values are never sent.

unit.description: The unit, for example "GB". Absent when the Spec has none.

SpecField.description: SpecField declares one Spec a ComponentType's Products can have.

unit.description: The unit, for example "GB". Absent when the Spec has none.

SpecValue.description: SpecValue is one Spec value. Exactly one value field is set, as the key's SpecField.type declares.

get.summary: List every Brand that has at least one Product.
get.description: A Brand with no Products is left out.

200.description: Every Brand that has Products, ordered by name.

get.summary: List every ComponentType, including those with no Products.
get.description: spec_schema declares every key and value type a Product's specs may hold.

get.summary: Get a Product by model_slug or model number.
get.description:
identifier is a model_slug, or a model number as a Retailer or the manufacturer writes it, percent-encoded. Store the model_slug in the response; never derive one. A model number containing "/" cannot travel in a path; send its model_slug.

A Product merged into another answers 301, with Location naming the survivor.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: A model_slug or model number. At most 256 bytes.

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: Set to "mcp" only by the DropHawk MCP server, to attribute the links it hands out. Leave it unset; any other value is treated as unset.

get.summary: Get a Product's daily lows over the last 14 days.
get.description:
A daily low is the lowest price seen on one UTC day across all Retailers, in stock or not, so it is not a history of best_price. Days with no observation have no point.

The window is today (UTC) and the 13 days before, starting at window_start. If an earlier point exists, the latest one is included with is_carried_forward set, so a chart can start at the window's first day. Identifiers and merges are handled as in GET /v1/products/{identifier}.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: A model_slug or model number. At most 256 bytes.

200.description: The Product's daily lows, or why they are withheld.

post.summary: Get up to 50 Products in one call.
post.description:
Each identifier is resolved as in GET /v1/products/{identifier}, and results[i] answers identifiers[i]. An identifier that cannot be resolved fails only its own result, so check each result, not the HTTP status. A merged Product resolves to its survivor with is_merged set, not a redirect. The batch counts as one request against the rate limit.

Connect callers may also GET it, but should POST large batches: a GET carries the batch in its URL, which can outgrow URL limits, and its response, per-item errors included, is cached publicly for 5 minutes.

200.description: One result per requested identifier, in request order.

get.description:
q is matched against name, Brand name and model number, tolerating typos, case and punctuation. Results come best match first; no match is an empty list.

To page, send next_page_token back as page_token with the same q; page_size may change between pages. Pages neither overlap nor skip while the catalog is unchanged.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The search text, for example "rtx 4090". Not blank; at most 256 bytes.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Products per page: 20 by default, at most 50 (larger values are served as 50). Negative is an error.

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: next_page_token from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: Set to "mcp" only by the DropHawk MCP server, to attribute the links it hands out. Leave it unset; any other value is treated as unset.

200.description: One page of matching Products, best match first.
